summary: Native agent mailboxes preserve canonical send order across graph and message-shard mail and replay pending offers when the same incarnation reconnects.

replay.detail: A transport reconnect reoffers this incarnation's pending messages, including staged recovery mail. It no longer treats socket-open time as a new harness boot. Earlier-incarnation offers remain historical.

schema.detail: No published schema or contract digest change.

rules.detail: No authority, retention or claim-admission change.

compatibility.detail: Full native mailbox snapshots and incremental updates use canonical send keys across both stores. Pagination namespaces are not delivery priority. Socket epochs and durable boot floors are logged on open and close; delivery-assessment transitions log their cause.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; no data conversion.

recovery.detail: Pending offers remain owned by their harness incarnation across transport reconnects. Unresolved staged recovery batches are reconstructed before choosing more backlog, preserving the five-outstanding bound. Message IDs and existing receipt idempotency preserve deduplication; no durable format changes.
